# telnyx_charges_breakdown (Data Source)

The monthly charges of the account's phone numbers for a period of up to 31 days, by number and service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `start_date` (String) Start date of the breakdown period

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) End date of the breakdown period

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency code
- `results` (Attributes List) List of phone number charge breakdowns (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))
- `user_email` (String) User email address
- `user_id` (String) User identifier

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `charge_type` (String) Type of charge for the number
- `service_owner_email` (String) Email address of the service owner
- `service_owner_user_id` (String) User ID of the service owner
- `services` (Attributes List) List of services associated with this number (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--services))
- `tn` (String) Phone number

<a id="nestedatt--results--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.services`

Read-Only:

- `cost` (String) Cost per unit as decimal string
- `cost_type` (String) Type of cost (MRC or OTC)
- `name` (String) Service name
